messages:
Leah (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A thread about promotions, leveling discrepancies, and timing. Dropping the promised clarifications here. Please ask follow-ups and we'll update the Notion doc.

Omar (Eng Manager): thanks. first q: are we shifting the promotion cycle dates this year?

Marco (Comp): No shift to the overall cycle. Manager packet deadline remains May 8. Calibration panels May 15-16. Final approvals by May 22.

Nina (IC4): heard talk about retroactive payouts for missed promotions last year. Is that policy changing?

Leah (People Ops): Retro pay is still exceptional only. We will consider retro pay for administrative errors or board-approved corrections. For missed submissions, managers should escalate before calibration closes.

Omar (Eng Manager): can you confirm the contents of the calibration packet? want to standardize across teams.

Leah (People Ops): checklist: role summary, 3-5 impact bullets, metrics/OKRs where applicable, concrete peer feedback excerpts, manager recommendation (level + comp), and any supporting docs (PRs, release notes). Template link coming.

Marco (Comp): also include current comp, target comp band, and any prior adjustments (market/merit) in the packet to help comp signals.

Ravi (CTO): reminder for managers: emphasize outcomes, scope expansion, and independence. Avoid vague phrases like "stepped up" without evidence.

Nina (IC4): leveling parity question: infra vs product — infra ICs feel held to higher bar for IC4. Are we publishing org-specific examples?

Marco (Comp): we will publish org-specific examples next week to reduce ambiguity. The rubric is unified; the examples will show how it maps to infra/product work. If you see repeated variance, file a bias/consistency report and People Ops will review trends.

Omar (Eng Manager): what about PIPs? can someone on a PIP be promoted if they show rapid improvement?

Leah (People Ops): standard rule: PIPs pause promotion eligibility until performance is sustained for one review period after the PIP closes. Exceptions require Executive sponsor and People Ops sign-off.

Nina (IC4): appeals process details? timeline and who reviews?

Marco (Comp): appeals open for 14 days after the manager conversation. Submit the appeal form (link in Notion) with manager notes and evidence. Reviewed by People Ops + 2 senior managers + Comp rep. Aim to resolve within 10 business days.

Leah (People Ops): bonus timing note: target payout window this year is June 15-30. We will post status updates in #people-ops if anything slips.

notion-bot: Uploaded templates & FAQ: https://redwoodinference.notion.site/Promo-Calibration-1773008765

Omar (Eng Manager): last ask: will managers get a preview of comp/headcount impact before final approvals? we need to plan hiring.

Marco (Comp): Yes — an estimated comp/headcount impact snapshot will be shared after calibration and before final approvals to assist planning. Big deltas will be flagged early.

Leah (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll update the Notion doc with these Q&As and drop the manager checklist and appeal form links here when ready. Office hours next Tue 10am PDT (managers) and Thu 4pm PDT (ICs) 5. :raised_hands:
